review.images: Eight project-specific Aldar renders extracted from the public UHP-hosted copy of The Beach House Fahid brochure. The gallery excludes generic island lifestyle imagery and other Fahid release renders.
review.location: Official brochure physical page 8 marks the Beach House development within Fahid and prints all five island-level times. The local map shows the whole labelled location panel from the left half, with the original PDF one click away.
review.floorPlans: Visually checked the 50-page source, including nineteen representative layouts on ten full physical pages 26–35. The UHP and official PDFs have the same layout pages. The Madena and Reelly PDF copies contain the same unit and building sheets, so were omitted. No drawing-specific whole-home areas are printed on the selected sheets.
